en: A color postcard showing a Renaissance-style loggia or gallery with stone columns on the left and a balustrade overlooking a garden. The vaulted ceiling is richly decorated with frescoes in vivid blues and earth tones, depicting mythological or allegorical human figures set against a sky-like background within painted architectural frames. The floor is tiled in a regular pattern, and potted plants line the column side. There is an arched doorway at the far end leading to another space. No printed text is visible on the image side.
